study type: descriptive, observational, cross-sectional, retrospective, homodemic study
cohort: 38 patients at risk of obstetric haemorrhage who underwent hypogastric artery ligation between June and December 2012 at Hospital General Regional n.o 36, Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social, Puebla
finding: Hypogastric artery ligation was associated with low rates of maternal and perinatal mortality, with only one patient experiencing a ureteral complication.
